text:
alex: Quick FYI — runtime/api references /guides/model-onboarding but the target moved to /guides/onboarding-models and the in-page anchor is different. Users hit a 404 when following the 'Model onboarding' link from quickstart. Anyone owning runtime/api.md?

tara: Which link exactly? can you paste the URL?

alex: Sure — from runtime/api.md: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/model-onboarding#steps
Target now is https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/onboarding-models#onboarding-steps

docs-bot: linkcheck: 404 on /guides/model-onboarding referenced from /runtime/api. First seen 2025-06-03.

devon: I can take the quick PR to point the link at the new path. If we worry about old bookmarks, we can add a short redirect on the guides side or an alias anchor.

jin: Adding a tiny redirect page is fine. Docs infra prefers adding a short markdown file at old path with frontmatter redirect_to: /guides/onboarding-models and a one-liner explaining the move. Also suggests a CI smoke curl test.

alex: Ok I'll open PR with three small parts: 1) fix the link in runtime/api.md, 2) add redirect stub at guides/model-onboarding/index.md, 3) add curl smoke test in docs smoke suite checking the original URL returns 302 -> final url includes onboarding-models.

devon: Ping me for review. I'll keep it small.

jin: For local testing, run this sed to patch runtime file and a curl check:

```bash
# replace path in runtime/api.md
sed -i "s@/guides/model-onboarding@/guides/onboarding-models@g" docs/runtime/api.md

# curl smoke check expects 302/200 final URL
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/model-onboarding" 
```

alex: I'll @docs-infra in the PR for the redirect frontmatter check. Targeting a tiny PR today, will request devon and tara as reviewers.

tara: thanks — small one-liner change is perfect. Also, can we add a quick KB note so localization teams know the guide slug changed? We had a similar issue last quarter with ja pages.

alex: Good call. I'll add a KB entry in /kb/doc-changes noting slug rename + recommended backport steps.

docs-bot: notice logged: docs.change (slug-migration) by alex. ID: dc-20250603-7

alex: PR opened: #3124 — small runtime link + redirect stub + smoke test. Requesting review devon, jin. Thanks!
